categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three integrated business segments: electronic products, R&D services and solutions, and high-level intelligent driving overall solutions. Its electronic products cover intelligent assisted driving, intelligent cockpit, intelligent networking, body and comfort domain, chassis control, and new energy and power systems. The R&D services focus on vehicle electronic and electrical development and testing, middleware, and proprietary toolchains. The intelligent driving solutions include autonomous driving vehicles and cloud-based fleet management systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), millimeter-wave radar, conditional autonomous driving, high-performance computing platforms (HPC), augmented reality head-up displays (AR-HUD), chassis control, remote communication units (T-BOX), and full-stack battery management systems (BMS). The company emphasizes software-defined automotive architectures (SOA), AUTOSAR middleware, AI-driven toolchains, and integrated hardware-software solutions. Production methods involve high-volume manufacturing of automotive electronic control units, domain controllers, and integrated platforms with stringent quality and safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, including brands like Geely, BYD, NIO, Changan, and international clients such as Stellantis, Scania, and BorgWarner. The company serves passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and specialized autonomous transport vehicles, with markets spanning traditional automotive electronics, new energy vehicles, and intelligent transportation systems. It also targets port automation and smart city applications through its autonomous driving solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant presence in major regions including East China, North China, Northeast, Southwest, Northwest, Central China, South China, and Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and R&D centers in the USA, Germany, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, supporting global OEMs and export markets. The overseas operations focus on enhancing R&D capabilities and localizing production to serve international clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive electronics supply chain. It develops and manufactures electronic control units, domain controllers, sensors, and software platforms that are integrated into vehicles by OEMs. It also provides R&D services and intelligent driving solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive technology and system supplier bridging component manufacturing and vehicle-level integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing intelligent automotive electronics with a focus on domain controllers, autonomous driving (L2+ to L4), AI-enabled R&D tools, and software-defined vehicle architectures. The company invests heavily in R&D, emphasizing AI integration, software ecosystems, and localization of chip platforms. It aims to expand intelligent driving MaaS (Mobility as a Service) offerings and deepen international market penetration while optimizing product portfolios for new energy and intelligent cockpit domains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of automotive electronic components and systems, including intelligent driving hardware and software. Additional income comes from R&D services and solutions contracts, licensing of proprietary software tools, and integrated intelligent driving solutions. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in automotive electronics and intelligent driving, competing with both international and local suppliers. It holds top market shares in body domain controllers, AR-HUD, and advanced driver assistance systems in China. Its full-stack self-developed solutions and integration capabilities provide competitive advantages against global Tier 1 suppliers and emerging Chinese competitors in the intelligent vehicle electronics sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.54 billion, an 18.46% increase year-over-year, driven by rapid growth in electronic product sales. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 550 million due to increased costs and R&D expenses. The company maintains total assets around RMB 9.4 billion with a workforce of over 7,300 employees, including a high proportion of R&D personnel. It continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for over 22% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive 'three-in-one' business model integrating products, R&D services, and intelligent driving solutions to provide full lifecycle support. Its unique value lies in full-stack self-developed hardware and software, advanced AI-enabled tools, and domain-specific integrated solutions tailored for intelligent and new energy vehicles. It balances innovation with quality and safety certifications, offering scalable, customizable, and high-performance automotive electronics that meet both domestic and international standards.
